topic: The last slice of pizza takes you to court
title: The People v. One Hungry Guy
hook: The last slice sues Dex for eating its father.
payoff: A delivery guarantee frees him; his victory snack starts the next case.

cast.role: the hungry defendant and first-person narrator
cast.design: Orange hoodie, teal cap, oval eyes, one crooked lace
Pepperoni triangle, basil tie, one missing corner, arched brows
Copper oven, dial eyes and a black robe; door doubles as the mouth
Three rows of four braided rolls with tiny eyebrows

scenes.camera: Low counter angle, ease toward the plaintiff at the first accusation.
scenes.action: Dex reaches across a pizza box. The last slice stands up inside it and slides a court summons toward his hand.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.visual: The lid springs open. Slice pops up with the summons.

beats.speaker: Slice
beats.visual: Slice points at Dex. Dex freezes halfway to the box.

scenes.camera: Cut to an overhead exhibit. Crash in toward the greasy fingerprint.
scenes.action: A magnifier follows the pizza-shaped grease print to Dex’s fingerprint.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.visual: The exhibit card skids onto the wood beside an empty plate.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.visual: A magnifier sweeps across the grease. The last print vanishes.

scenes.camera: Rack the composition upward through the rows. End on the foreman.
scenes.action: Jurors rise in sequence. The foreman deliberately turns his back on Dex.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.line: I demanded a jury of my peers.
beats.visual: Twelve little silhouettes stir behind the jury rail.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.visual: Three rows stand one after another, then glare.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.line: [deadpan] Tough room. I had garlic breath.
beats.visual: A green breath curl drifts past the foreman; all twelve recoil.

scenes.camera: Hard cut to a symmetrical front view of the judge; push toward the timer.
scenes.action: The judge opens the oven door. The timer starts, overshoots, and gives Dex an idea.

beats.speaker: Judge
beats.visual: The door opens, showing orange coils and a thirty-minute dial.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.visual: The last digit flips. Dex looks from the clock to the box.

scenes.camera: Overhead close-up. Track the tapping finger to the printed guarantee.
scenes.action: Dex flips the box lid and invokes the delivery rule. The judge stamps the ticket.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.visual: The lid unfolds, revealing its original printed rule.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.line: Thirty minutes or I go free.
beats.visual: Dex taps FREE. A receipt gets stamped RELEASED.

beats.speaker: Judge
beats.visual: The receipt bounces once while the oven light fades.

scenes.camera: Match the opening box angle. Rack focus from a snapped breadstick to a fresh summons.
scenes.action: Dex celebrates with one bite. The bitten breadstick already has legal representation.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.visual: The breadstick cracks into two pieces in front of Dex.

beats.speaker: Dex
beats.visual: The bitten end raises a briefcase. A fresh summons lands in the opening position.
